description: The E-Bilanz of a company for one Wirtschaftsjahr and Bilanzart (§ 5b EStG): Bilanz, GuV, Betriebsvermögensvergleich, Anlagenspiegel and Kontensalden on the HGB-Taxonomie, computed from the general ledger, the assets and the Balance Sheet Mapping.

fields.description: The year the Wirtschaftsjahr ends in.
fields.label: Year

fields.description: The Eröffnungsbilanz of the founding year (§ 5b Abs. 1 Satz 4 EStG) shows the Bilanz on the first day of the Wirtschaftsjahr, without GuV and Betriebsvermögensvergleich.
fields.label: Kind of Balance Sheet

fields.description: A Berichtigung of the E-Bilanz filed for the year and the Bilanzart, made with Make Berichtigung; it names its Status des Berichts.
fields.label: Correction

fields.description: E erstmalig, which Steuerbote sets for the first E-Bilanz; a Berichtigung names B berichtigt, G geändert, BG berichtigt und geändert, sK sonstige Korrektur or I identischer Abschluss mit differenzierteren Informationen (FAQ zur E-Bilanz, Version 2026-01, Tz. 4 d).
fields.label: Status of the Report
fields.options:
E
B
G
BG
sK
I

fields.description: The end of the Wirtschaftsjahr, of an Eröffnungsbilanz its first day.
fields.label: Balance Sheet Date

fields.description: Set while Prüfen, Testsenden or Senden runs; the E-Bilanz cannot change until it ends.
fields.label: Transmission Running

fields.description: HAOE: Einheitsbilanz, a Handelsbilanz that is the Steuerbilanz; HGBM: Handelsbilanz with the Überleitungsrechnung; AO: Steuerbilanz (Technischer Leitfaden zur HGB-Taxonomie 6.9, B.13). The form of a new E-Bilanz takes that of the Annual Filing Settings.
fields.label: Accounting Standard

fields.description: The version of the HGB-Taxonomie whose positions the E-Bilanz reports; the Balance Sheet Mapping names the same.
fields.label: HGB Taxonomy

fields.description: The Wirtschaftsjahr in which the company was founded: nothing was acquired before it, and its Betriebsvermögen at the end of the previous year is zero.
fields.label: Founding Year

fields.description: The finance book of the Handelsbilanz and of the Einheitsbilanz; empty, the entries without a finance book. A new E-Bilanz takes that of the Annual Filing Settings.
fields.label: Finance Book of the Handelsbilanz

fields.description: The finance book „Steuerbilanz“: for AO the books of the E-Bilanz, for HGBM the Überleitungsrechnung follows from its differences to the Handelsbilanz. Without one, a Handelsbilanz takes its Überleitungsrechnung by hand.
fields.label: Finance Book of the Steuerbilanz

fields.description: The positions of Bilanz, GuV and Betriebsvermögensvergleich the E-Bilanz reports, filled by Calculate, a Mussfeld the books do not fill as NIL. A correction reports another amount of a position without positions under it and needs a reason; a line by hand names a position and gives its amount as the correction, with a reason.
fields.label: Positions

fields.description: After the Überleitungsrechnung; the Körperschaftsteuererklärung starts from it.
fields.label: Jahresüberschuss of the Steuerbilanz

fields.description: The Eigenkapital less the „nicht durch Eigenkapital gedeckter Fehlbetrag“ at the Bilanzstichtag.
fields.label: Betriebsvermögen of the Steuerbilanz

fields.description: Calculated: that of the filed E-Bilanz of the previous year, else that of the books at the beginning of the Wirtschaftsjahr; zero in the founding year.
fields.label: Betriebsvermögen at the End of the Previous Year
Betriebsvermögen of the Previous Year by the Company

fields.description: Required for the Betriebsvermögen of the previous year by the company, such as that of a Bescheid; without a reason Calculate takes the calculated one.
fields.label: Reason for the Betriebsvermögen of the Previous Year

fields.description: In the founding year, the Eigenkapital of the Eröffnungsbilanz.
fields.label: Einlagen at the Founding

fields.description: Einlagen and Kapitalzuführungen of the Wirtschaftsjahr beyond those at the founding.
fields.label: Further Einlagen

fields.description: A row per asset category and value type, filled by Calculate from the report Asset Depreciations and Balances. Umbuchungen, Zuschreibungen and the Abschreibungen the Asset module does not book by category are entered by hand, with a reason; they take up the adjustments of ERPNext. A row by hand names its position and gives every column, with a reason.
fields.label: Anlagenspiegel

fields.description: The differences of the Steuerbilanz to the Handelsbilanz, each in the direction of its position: filled by Calculate from the finance book of the Steuerbilanz, or entered by hand with a reason. The steuerlicher Ausgleichsposten follows from them.
fields.label: Überleitungsrechnung

fields.description: The Kontennachweis: every account of the books with a balance, on the position it goes to, in the direction of the position.
fields.label: Account Balances

fields.description: Required to file an E-Bilanz that is not ready: why it is correct nonetheless.
fields.label: Remarks

name: Electronic Balance Sheet
